description: Invented flight schedules, prices, and availability for development. Airport locations are real; these are not real scheduled airline services.
price_basis: Stored integer cents per adult passenger for one flight segment, including sample taxes and excluding optional services. These are fixed sample prices, not a dynamic pricing algorithm.
inventory_note: Each cabin shares one available-seat count across all its fare tiers. Initial occupied seats are fictional starting occupancy, not generated customer bookings. Some business cabins are sold out; every flight has available economy seats.
